how.title: How CrushDuo works
how.subtitle: Sincere connections, at your own pace, at any age. Here is the path, from signing up to your first conversation… and your first date.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.text: With your email (or Google) and a password, or simply a magic link. You confirm your address and that you are an adult: CrushDuo is for people aged 18 and over.

profile.title: Tell your story
profile.text: Add your best photos, a few words about you, your interests and your intention. Answer personality questions: this is what makes people want to write to you.

discover.title: Discover compatible people
discover.text: Your criteria come first: age, city, intentions. Each profile shows an estimated affinity and why it is suggested to you. Every day, a limited selection awaits you, with no pressure.

like.title: Say what you like
like.text: Like a profile, a photo, an answer or an interest, and add a short note if you wish. It becomes your first message if you match.

match.title: It’s a match
match.text: When interest is mutual, you are both notified and the conversation opens.

chat.title: Chat comfortably
chat.text: Private real-time messages, reactions, targeted replies and conversation starters based on what you have in common. You can block or report in one tap.

date.title: Meet in person, safely
date.text: Suggest a date in a public place, pick the time, set a reminder and share the details with someone you trust, only if you decide to.

premium.title: Go further with Premium / VIP (optional)
premium.text: More visibility and tools, never a guaranteed match. Blocking, reporting and safety stay free for everyone.

why.p: You know why a profile is suggested to you. Your looks are never used to rank people.
No fake profiles, fake Likes or fake messages. The “verified” badge is only given after a human check.
No countdowns or endless scrolling: a limited selection, and a profile you can hide whenever you like.
Your conversations are private, your location is never precise, your data can be exported.

about.title: About CrushDuo
about.lead: Behind every family, there was a day when two strangers looked at each other differently.
about.mission: We’re building CrushDuo to make serious dating and beautiful stories easier between adults, in francophone Africa and beyond, in an environment where everyone feels safe.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: No harassment, no shocking content. Our community rules are enforced.

safety.title: Safety
safety.text: Human moderation, blocking, reporting and action against fake profiles and scams.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: Blurred location, export and deletion of your data at any time.

sincerity.title: Sincerity
sincerity.text: A verified badge is only earned after a real check. No fake testimonials.

c1.title: It all starts with a glance
c1.p1: Every great family has a first chapter. A glance across a wedding hall, a shy message sent one evening, a “hello” that could have gone unanswered. Nobody plans that tiny moment, yet everything else flows from it: the home, the children, Sunday meals, the laughter, the silences that reassure.
c1.p2: We started from a simple conviction: that first chapter deserves every chance.

c2.title: Meeting people has never been so easy… or so hard
c2.p1: We’re more connected than ever, yet so many sincere people feel alone. Too many profiles, too many promises, too many conversations that fade after two messages. Many are looking for someone to build something real with, and end up lost in the noise, sometimes exposed to fake profiles and scams.
c2.p2: CrushDuo was born for those who want something else: less showcase, more meaning.

c3.title: A platform built to build, not to consume
c3.p1: Here, we don’t ask you to be perfect, we help you be understood. Your intentions, values, interests, city and languages matter more than any photo. Our compatibility score is never based on appearance.
c3.p2: And when two people truly like each other, live matching lets them talk right away, while they’re both there, with a genuine wish to connect.

c4.title: Trust is the first foundation
c4.p1: You can’t build a family on doubt. That’s why we keep the platform for adults, moderate with real people, grant the “verified” badge only after a real check, blur your location, and let you export or delete your data whenever you want.
c4.p2: Every rule we enforce has the same purpose: so you can open your heart without lowering your guard.

c5.title: Our dream: families that begin here
c5.p1: We dream of the day a couple tells us: “We met on CrushDuo.” Of the day children ask how their parents met, and the answer begins with a simple profile, a simple “Like”.
c5.p2: We don’t sell promises. We build the conditions for beautiful stories to happen: a respectful, safe, human-sized place, in francophone Africa and beyond.

about.nextTitle: The next one might be you.
about.nextText: Somewhere, the person who will change your life may be creating their profile right now. And the next family story we tell may well be that of whoever is reading these lines. Your first chapter starts here.

start.a: Only people aged 18 and over. Your date of birth is checked at sign-up, and CrushDuo welcomes adults of every age.
Yes to get started: profile, discovery, daily picks, matches and messaging are free, with a daily number of likes. Premium and VIP add features, without ever guaranteeing a match.

start.q: I did not receive the confirmation email
start.a: Check your spam folder, then use “Resend” in the banner at the top of the app.

start.q: How do I get better matches?
start.a: Complete your profile: several photos, an honest introduction, your interests and 3 to 5 personality questions. Answers make people want to write to you.

start.q: I no longer see new profiles
start.a: Widen your criteria (age, city, intentions) in Profile → My dating criteria, or come back tomorrow: new people join every day.

meet.q: What does the affinity percentage mean?
meet.a: It is an estimate based on your preferences and theirs (intentions, interests, city…). It comes with its reasons and guarantees nothing: real compatibility is discovered by talking.

meet.q: What are “Your picks of the day”?
meet.a: A limited selection of real compatible profiles, refreshed every day. There is no countdown: browse at your own pace and revisit previous days.

meet.q: How do I send a Like with a comment?
meet.a: Open a profile, pick what you like (the profile, a photo, an answer or an interest) and add a note if you wish. If you match, the note becomes your first message.

meet.q: Why have I run out of likes today?
meet.a: The free plan includes a number of likes per day. It resets every day; Premium removes the limit.

meet.q: What is the Crush menu for?
meet.a: It starts a live search among online people who fit your criteria. Those who accept appear: chatting with one costs a Match token, and you can always like for free.

chat.q: I don’t know how to start the conversation
chat.a: Tap the light bulb in the message box: ideas based on what you have in common are suggested. Nothing is sent without your approval, and you can edit the text.

chat.q: Can I react or reply to a message?
chat.a: Yes: tap a message to react with an emoji or reply to that specific message.
The “seen” indicator shows that a message was read. Premium and VIP members can turn off sending their receipts in Settings → Privacy; the typing indicator can be turned off by everyone.

chat.q: How do I suggest a date?
chat.a: In the conversation, tap the Dates icon: choose a day, a time and a public place. The other person can accept, decline or suggest another time.

chat.q: How do I tell someone I trust about my date?
chat.a: On an accepted date, “Share with someone I trust” creates a link you send yourself: it shows the place, time and first names, nothing else. You can stop it at any time.

safety.q: How do I spot a romance scam?
safety.a: Be wary of any request for money, repeated refusal of a video call, a very fast declaration of love or an emergency. Send nothing, and report the profile.

safety.q: How do I report a profile?
safety.a: Open the profile or the conversation, then “Report”. Your report is confidential and a moderator reviews every report.

safety.q: What happens if I block someone?
safety.a: You no longer see each other and the conversation is closed. You can unblock from settings. Blocking and reporting are always free.

safety.q: How do I get the verified badge?
safety.a: Profile → Verification: send a selfie. A moderator compares it with your photos, then deletes it. The badge is never granted automatically and does not guarantee a person’s intentions.

safety.q: My account is suspended: what can I do?
safety.a: A page shows the reason for the decision and lets you appeal: your message is reviewed by the team.

billing.a: Mobile Money (depending on your country) and bank card through our secure provider. We store no banking data.
No: each period is a one-off payment. We warn you before it ends so you can extend it.

billing.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
billing.a: Settings → Subscription → Cancel. You keep your benefits until the end of the paid period.

billing.q: Where can I find my invoices?
billing.a: Settings → Payments: every successful payment has its invoice.
No benefit is activated until the payment is confirmed. Try again from the Premium page, or contact us with the payment reference.
Write to us from the Contact page with the payment reference: every request is reviewed, especially for double payments or errors.

billing.q: Do my boosts and Super Likes expire?
billing.a: No: purchased credits stay on your account until you use them.

privacy.a: From the login page, choose “Forgot password”: a link valid for one hour is sent to you. You can also sign in with a magic link.

privacy.q: How do I sign out of another device?
privacy.a: Settings → Security → Connected devices, then “Sign out”.
Never precisely: only a rounded distance may appear, and only if you share your location.
You and the person you are talking to. We do not browse conversations; a report relies on your description and the reported profile.

privacy.q: How do I hide my profile or take a break?
privacy.a: Settings → Privacy → turn off “Visible profile”. Come back whenever you like. Incognito mode is reserved for VIP.

privacy.q: Can I get my data or delete my account?
privacy.a: Yes: Settings → Privacy → Export my data (JSON file) or Delete my account. Deletion is permanent.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.metaDescription: CrushDuo’s terms of use: access, account, content, paid plans, moderation and responsibilities, explained simply.
terms.lead: This document explains, simply and honestly, the rules between you and CrushDuo. We wanted it to be readable: if in doubt, write to us.

paras: CrushDuo is an online service that connects adults who want to meet people, at any age. By creating an account, you accept these terms and our community guidelines.
If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the service.
The service is reserved for people aged at least 18. Your date of birth is checked at sign-up; any false information about your age leads to the deletion of the account.
Each person may have only one account and must provide accurate information.

You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for the activity of your account. You can see and sign out your devices in Settings → Security, and we advise choosing a unique password.
Tell us without delay if you think your account has been used without your knowledge.

sections.intro: We want happy, safe encounters for everyone. Our community guidelines detail what this means; here is the essentials.

items: Harassment, threats, discrimination and humiliating remarks.
Identity theft and fake profiles.
Requests for money, scams and commercial solicitation.
Illegal, violent or sexually explicit content, and any image involving a minor.

paras: The photos, texts, answers, comments and messages you publish remain yours. You only authorise us to host and display them to make the service work, to the people concerned and according to your visibility settings.
You may only publish content you have the right to use, without harming others. We may remove content that breaches these terms or the community guidelines.

CrushDuo is free to start. Paid plans (Premium, VIP) and one-off purchases (boosts, Super Likes, Crush tokens) unlock extra features. Prices, durations and benefits are shown on the Pricing page before any payment.

items: Plans exist for 1, 3, 6 or 12 months. Each period is a one-off payment: the subscription does not renew automatically and we warn you before it ends.
You can cancel at any time: you keep your benefits until the end of the paid period.
Purchased credits (boosts, Super Likes, tokens) stay on your account until used.
No offer guarantees a match or a relationship: it gives more visibility and tools.
Blocking, reporting and safety features stay free for everyone.

paras: Payments are processed by a secure provider (Mobile Money depending on the country, bank card); we keep no banking data. A benefit is only activated once the payment is confirmed, and an invoice is available in Settings → Payments.
For a refund request (double payment, error…), write to us with the payment reference: every request is reviewed.

We may remove content, temporarily suspend an account or exclude it when the rules are not respected, in proportion to severity. The reason for the decision is shared with you and you can appeal from your account: your message is reviewed by the team.
Your conversations are not browsed by the team: a report relies on the member’s description and the reported profile.

CrushDuo connects people but cannot guarantee the identity, intentions or behaviour of members. The “verified profile” badge means a moderator compared a selfie with the profile’s photos; it is not a guarantee.
For a first meeting, choose a public place, tell someone you trust and arrive by your own means. Meetings take place under your own responsibility, to the extent the law allows.

We do our best to keep the service available and safe, but it may be interrupted for maintenance or incidents. Some features may be enabled, changed or suspended (for example in case of abuse), without affecting the benefits you paid for.

We process your data to run the service and protect you. Your precise location is never shown, you can export your data and delete your account at any time from Settings → Privacy. Details are in our privacy policy.

You can delete your account at any time: deletion is permanent. We may suspend or close an account in case of serious or repeated breach, under the conditions of the “Moderation and sanctions” section.
We may update these terms, for example to add a feature or meet a legal obligation. In case of an important change, we will inform you in the app or by email before it applies.

The governing law and competent jurisdiction will be specified here before launch, after legal review of this document. In case of disagreement, write to us first: we always look for an amicable solution.
Write to us from the Contact page: we will gladly answer.

sections.p: Email, date of birth, gender, city, photos, bio, interests, interactions (likes, messages), payment data processed by the provider.
Provide the service, suggest compatible profiles, ensure safety and moderation, manage subscriptions.
Your exact location is never stored or shown: if you share it, it is rounded (about 11 km) before saving.
Metadata (EXIF, GPS) is removed on upload. Verification selfies are deleted after a decision.
Access, correction, export (Settings → Privacy), account deletion, withdrawal of marketing consent at any time.
Data is deleted or anonymized when you delete your account, subject to legal obligations (billing, security).

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.metaDescription: CrushDuo’s cookies and storage, listed one by one: what they do, how long they last, and how to manage them. No advertising, no tracking.
cookies.lead: Let’s talk cookies, without jargon and without hiding anything. CrushDuo only uses the bare minimum to sign you in and remember your preferences: no advertising, no tracking, no selling of data.

glance.p: No advertising cookies and no tracking across sites.
No audience-measurement tool, no social-network pixel.
Staying signed in, remembering your language and preferences.
You can see, block or erase everything from your browser.

sections.intro: A cookie is a small file your browser keeps to remember something between two visits. We use very few, and only so the service works the way you want.

items: Only essential cookies and storage, or ones tied to a choice you make yourself, are used.
Nothing stored is used to follow you from site to site or to target you with advertising.
That is why the notice shown on your first visit asks you for no choice: it simply informs you.

sections.h: What we store, one by one
sections.intro: Here is the complete list. Preferences (language, theme, Enter key) stay in your browser; they are not sent to profile you.

paras: The session cookie is the only essential cookie: without it you would have to type your password on every page. It is “httpOnly” (unreachable by page scripts), sent over a secure connection and limited to our site.

By default it disappears when you close the browser. If you tick “Stay signed in”, it lasts 30 days: only use this on a device you own. You can see and sign out your devices at any time in Settings › Security.
Your language, your light or dark theme and the “Enter sends” choice are comfort settings. If you clear them, CrushDuo simply starts again with its defaults.

sections.h: Trusted services you choose to use
sections.intro: Two external services are only loaded when you use them. They may set their own cookies, under their own policies, which we do not control.

items: Sign in with Google: Google’s button is only loaded on the sign-in and sign-up pages, and only if this option is enabled.
Payment: when you pay for a subscription or a purchase, our secure payment provider’s window loads. We keep no banking data.
Advertising or targeting cookies.
Audience-measurement or behaviour-analysis tools.
Social-network pixels and buttons that follow you.
Selling or sharing of your browsing data.

paras: Every browser lets you view, block or delete cookies and local storage (in its privacy settings). Note: blocking the session cookie will prevent you from signing in, and erasing everything signs you out and resets your preferences.
Signing out from CrushDuo immediately removes the session cookie from the device.

If we ever added an audience-measurement tool or another tracker, we would ask for your agreement before turning it on, and this page would be updated. You could then refuse without losing access to the service.
Write to us from the Contact page: we gladly answer, even detailed questions.

community.title: Community guidelines
community.metaDescription: CrushDuo’s code of kindness: respect, sincerity, safety and privacy, for happy relationships at any age.
community.lead: You can find love at any age. CrushDuo brings together adults aged 18 and over who are looking for a real relationship, and everyone has the right to do so with respect, sincerity and peace of mind. These rules are here so you feel good here.

glance.p: Everyone is treated with consideration, whatever their age, background or appearance.
Real photos, real intentions: it is easier to build on what is true.
Never money, never pressure. When in doubt, stop and report.
Your conversations and your location belong to you.
A “no” or a silence is an answer. Everyone goes at their own pace.

sections.intro: At 25, 40, 55 or 70, you have every reason to dream of a beautiful story. Here, age is neither a joke nor a flaw: it is a journey. CrushDuo welcomes all adults, whatever their origin, situation, way of loving or appearance, on one condition: respect others.

items: Honest introductions that say who you are and what you are looking for.
Curiosity about the other person, their stories and their pace.
Sincere compliments, never aimed at age or looks to put someone down.

sections.intro: A meeting starts with a kind look. Speak the way you would like to be spoken to.

items: Reply politely, even to say no, thank you.
Accept a negative answer or a silence without insisting.
Ask open questions rather than judge.
Insults, mockery, threats or humiliating remarks.
Harassment: repeated messages after a refusal, pressure, insistence.
Any discrimination based on age, origin, religion, orientation, gender, disability, health or family situation.
Unrequested remarks about someone’s body or age.

sections.intro: A couple’s story is not built on a misunderstanding. Show yourself as you are.

items: Recent photos in which you are recognisable.
Your real age and real intentions (serious relationship, marriage, friendship, or “not sure yet”).
A frank description of your personal situation.
Fake profiles and identity theft.
Photos of someone else or taken without their consent.
Profiles created to deceive, to sell, or to collect information.
The “verified profile” badge is only granted after a real check: a moderator compares your selfie with your photos, then the selfie is deleted.

sections.intro: Romance scams all look alike. One simple rule protects us all: nobody needs your money to love you.

items: Asking for or offering money, a transfer, a prepaid card or a “gift” to pay for.
Pushing you to invest, lend, or share codes or banking details.
Saying “I love you” very quickly to win your trust, then mentioning an emergency.
Warning signs: repeated refusal of a video call, stories that are too perfect, urgency, secrecy, a quick move to another app.
When in doubt: stop the conversation, send nothing, and report the profile. It protects others too.

sections.intro: CrushDuo is a dating place for all ages: let’s keep content that makes everyone comfortable.

items: Sexually explicit, violent, shocking or illegal content.
Any image involving a minor: zero tolerance.
Photos of third parties without consent, private conversation screenshots shared publicly.
Advertising, solicitation and spam.
Keep your contact details (phone, address, social media) for when you feel confident, not before.

sections.intro: A successful first date starts with a few simple precautions. They do not spoil the magic: they let you enjoy it with peace of mind.

items: Choose a public, busy place for the first meeting.
Tell someone you trust: Dates mode lets you share the place and time with them, only if you decide to.
Arrive and leave by your own means.
Trust your instinct: you can cancel or leave at any time without explaining.

sections.intro: You decide what you show, to whom, and how far.

items: Your location is never shown precisely: only an approximate distance is used.
Your conversations are private: we do not browse them. A report relies on your description and the reported profile.
You can hide your profile, adjust read receipts and the typing indicator, export your data or delete your account at any time.
Sharing another person’s private information (photos, contact details, conversations) without consent.
Trying to identify or track down someone who does not wish to be contacted.

sections.intro: Something makes you uncomfortable? You do not have to justify yourself or wait.

items: Block: you no longer see each other and the conversation closes. It is immediate, and you can unblock from settings.
Report from a profile or a conversation (“⋮” menu then “Report”): fake profile, scam, harassment, inappropriate content, minor, spam, other.
Your report is confidential and reviewed by a moderator.
Blocking and reporting are always free, whatever your plan.

sections.h: If the rules are not respected
sections.intro: Our first aim is to protect the community, with proportion and fairness.

items: Depending on severity: removal of content or a photo, temporary suspension, or a ban for the most serious cases (scam, harassment, minor).
The reason for the decision is shared with you.
You can appeal a suspension from your account: your message is reviewed by the team.
No sanction is taken over appearance, age or opinions, only over behaviour.

sections.h: Look after yourself, at your own pace
sections.intro: Meeting someone is a path, not a race. Take your time.

items: Need a break? Hide your profile in Settings › Privacy: come back whenever you like.
A conversation weighs on you? You are under no obligation to reply.
Set your limits from the start: a respectful partner welcomes them gladly.
We avoid artificial pressure: no fake profiles, fake Likes or fake messages, and your looks are never used to rank profiles.

sections.intro: Our team is here to listen. Write to us from the Contact page or browse the Help centre: we take every message seriously.

community.finalText: Join a community that respects itself, where people take the time to get to know each other.

promos.title: Promo codes
promos.subtitle: Percentage discounts or free Crush tokens. A code can be used once per member.
promos.immutable: A code’s type and value never change: disable it and create a new one.

ff.title: Features
ff.subtitle: Turn a feature on or off without redeploying. Click the i icon to understand what each switch does.
ff.note: The block is enforced by the server: even an old open tab cannot bypass a switched-off feature. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

registration_open.name: Registration open
registration_open.what: Allows new people to create an account (form and Google).
registration_open.off: No new account is created. Existing members keep signing in normally.
registration_open.useWhen: When fake accounts flood in, or during maintenance.

payments_enabled.name: Payments
payments_enabled.what: Allows starting new payments: subscriptions, Crush tokens, boosts, Super Likes.
payments_enabled.off: No new purchase can start. A payment already started can complete, and refunds remain possible.
payments_enabled.useWhen: When the payment provider has an outage or maintenance.

promo_codes.name: Promo codes
promo_codes.what: Allows entering promo codes (percentage discounts and free tokens).
promo_codes.off: All codes are refused; purchases without a code continue normally.
promo_codes.useWhen: If a code leaks or is being abused.

boosts.name: Visibility boosts
boosts.what: Allows activating boosts (bought or included in a plan).
boosts.off: Boosts can no longer be activated; members’ credits stay intact.
boosts.useWhen: If ranking of boosted profiles causes trouble.

live_match.name: Live Crush
live_match.what: The Crush menu: criteria, invitations to people online, chats paid with tokens.
live_match.off: Crush is unavailable for everyone; tokens and existing chats are kept.
live_match.useWhen: In case of observed abuse or server overload.

super_likes.name: Super Likes
super_likes.off: Super Likes are refused; regular likes continue and credits are kept.
super_likes.useWhen: In case of a counting bug or abuse.

chat_images.name: Photos in messages
chat_images.off: No more image sending; text continues and images already sent stay visible.
chat_images.useWhen: If inappropriate images arrive in bulk and moderation is overwhelmed.

referral_program.name: Referral program
referral_program.what: Enables invitation links and token rewards.
referral_program.on: Referred friends are linked and rewarded.
referral_program.off: No new referral is linked and no reward is paid; pending referrals are rewarded when re-enabled.
referral_program.useWhen: If referrals are abused (fake accounts, invitation loops).

profile_prompts.name: Personality questions
profile_prompts.what: Lets members answer profile questions shown on cards.
profile_prompts.on: Answers can be edited and are visible.
profile_prompts.off: Answers are hidden and cannot be edited; they are kept.

like_comments.name: Likes with comments
like_comments.what: Lets members target an item (photo, answer, interest) and add a comment to a Like.
like_comments.on: The comment goes with the Like and becomes the first message on a match.
like_comments.off: Only the plain Like remains possible.

daily_picks.name: Daily picks
daily_picks.what: Offers a limited selection of compatible profiles every day.
daily_picks.on: The Daily picks page is available.
daily_picks.off: The page and its history are unavailable; classic discovery continues.
daily_picks.useWhen: If the selection has quality or load problems.

message_reactions.name: Message reactions
message_reactions.what: Lets members react to a message with an emoji.
message_reactions.off: Reactions are hidden and unavailable; they are kept.

message_replies.name: Message replies
message_replies.what: Lets members reply to a specific message (quote).
message_replies.off: Quotes are hidden; plain messaging continues.

icebreakers.name: Icebreakers
icebreakers.what: Suggests first-message ideas based on what both people have in common.
icebreakers.on: The “Ideas to get started” button is available.
icebreakers.off: The button disappears; nothing else changes.
icebreakers.useWhen: If suggestions have a quality problem.

date_proposals.name: Dates
date_proposals.what: Lets members propose, accept and organise a date inside a conversation.
date_proposals.on: The Dates button is available in conversations.
date_proposals.off: No new proposals or answers; existing dates stay visible and can still be canceled.
date_proposals.useWhen: If the feature is abused. A member is never trapped in an already planned date.

pause_mode.name: Pause mode
pause_mode.what: Lets a member pause their account (invisible, no alerts).
pause_mode.on: The Pause button is available in settings.
pause_mode.off: No new pauses; current pauses can still be ended by the member.
pause_mode.useWhen: If the feature is abused. A member can always resume.

profile_tips.name: Profile tips
profile_tips.what: Shows concrete tips to improve one’s profile.
profile_tips.on: The tips card appears on the Profile page.
profile_tips.off: The card disappears; nothing else changes.
profile_tips.useWhen: If the tips have a quality problem.

calls.name: Audio and video calls
calls.what: Lets two members of an active match call each other (audio or video) through a third-party service. Nothing is recorded.
calls.on: Call buttons appear in the conversation.
calls.off: No new calls; ongoing calls may finish.
calls.useWhen: In case of abuse, unexpected cost or an incident at the video provider.

speed_dating.name: Speed dating
speed_dating.what: Lets members sign up for the text speed-dating sessions published by the team.
speed_dating.on: The Speed dating page is open for sign-ups and chats.
speed_dating.off: No new sign-ups or messages; decisions already made are kept.
speed_dating.useWhen: In case of abuse, or to suspend all sessions.

daily_question.name: Question of the day
daily_question.what: Shows a question shared by all members; answering reveals the answers of the people in your daily picks.
daily_question.on: The “Question of the day” card appears on the Picks page.
daily_question.off: The card and the answers on cards disappear; answers already given are kept.
daily_question.useWhen: If a question causes a problem, or to pause the feature.

safe.killHint: The switches turn a feature off without redeploying.
safe.privacyHint: Members’ emails are not copied or sent elsewhere.

renew.a: No. Mobile Money payments do not allow reliable recurring debits: each period is a one-off payment. We notify you before the end so you can extend.

cancel.a: Yes, anytime in Settings → Subscription. You keep your benefits until the end of the paid period.

momo.a: Mobile Money (MTN, Moov, Wave depending on the country) and bank card through our secure payment provider. We never store banking data.

refund.a: Write to us via the Contact page with your payment reference: each request is reviewed, notably for double payments or errors.

guarantee.a: No. No subscription guarantees a match or a relationship: it gives you more visibility and tools.

credits.q: Do my boosts and Super Likes expire?
credits.a: No, purchased credits stay on your account until used.

rhythm.title: Your pace
rhythm.intro: Meeting someone is not a race. Set CrushDuo to your own pace: you always stay in control.
rhythm.pauseText: You are invisible in discovery, you stop receiving alerts and you cannot like, while you catch your breath. Your conversations and matches stay right here.
rhythm.resumed: Welcome back! Your profile is visible again.
rhythm.paused: Pause on. Take care of yourself.
rhythm.quietText: During this period, alerts and emails are muted; you find everything in the app. Security and subscription alerts are always sent.
rhythm.remindersText: Receive a reminder before a date, when you chose one.
rhythm.emailCap: For your peace of mind, you receive at most {n} emails a day (security and subscription excluded).
rhythm.pausedEmptyText: Take the time you need. When you are ready, resume in one tap: everything is waiting for you.

speed.subtitle: Short written chats with people who want the same things as you. No pressure: you privately choose who you would like to see again.
speed.h1: You sign up for a session that suits you.
speed.h2: At the set time, you chat in writing for a few minutes with one person at a time.
speed.h3: At the end, you privately say who you would like to see again. It is a match only if it is mutual.
speed.safe: For your safety: keep your contact details for after the match; you can report, block or leave at any time.
speed.empty: No session is announced right now. Come back soon: new sessions are published regularly.
